title: api.chat.ts starts a never-cleared setInterval and an unbounded module orderCache Map when it is imported.
evidence: (a) app/routes/api.chat.ts:148 creates a module Map orderCache keyed by customerId. :150-155 starts a 5-minute setInterval at import that deletes expired entries. It is never stored, cleared or unref'd. (b) getCachedOrders (:157-166) is the only reader and writer, called from action at :511. The route is also imported by app/lib/app-routes.server.ts:8. 15 api.chat*.test.ts files import it. None can clear the cache or stop the interval. api.chat-daily-turns.test.ts:58 re-imports it dynamically, which starts another interval. (c) Owner: a createOrderCache({ttl}) returning {get, set, stop}, built once in the server entry and passed to the action, or a named startOrderCacheSweep() returning stop(). Then nothing runs at import, and tests could build a fresh cache per case. (d) Risk: each dev hot reload or test re-import may add one more interval, and the old Map stays alive in the old closure (inferred, not confirmed). The Map has no size cap, only TTL. Same pattern at app/lib/subscription-gateway.server.ts:124-125 and app/lib/supabase-guest.server.ts:42.
